long.title: Aakhri Ghar – Aage Kya Hua? 🏠 Ramu Ki Poori Kahani | Hindi Moral Story | Kissa Aur Seekh
long.description:
आख़िरी घर – आगे क्या हुआ? 🏠

Ramu mistri ne apni zindagi ka sabse kharab ghar banaya… aur woh ghar usi ka nikla. Ab Ramu, uski patni Kamla aur pota Chhotu usi kamzor ghar mein rehte hain. Phir aata hai pehla monsoon, aur Chhotu ek aisa sawaal poochta hai jo Ramu ko andar tak hila deta hai. Kya Ramu apni galti sudhaar paayega?

Seekh: Galti har insaan se hoti hai. Sachcha insaan wahi hai jo apni galti maane aur use sudhaare.
